install:
[ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" ] || curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
sudo -n ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/uv"  /usr/local/bin/uv 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/uvx" /usr/local/bin/uvx 2>/dev/null || true
command -v snyk >/dev/null 2>&1 || { arch=$(uname -m); case "$arch" in aarch64|arm64) suffix="-arm64";; *) suffix="";; esac; curl --compressed -fsSL "https://static.snyk.io/cli/latest/snyk-linux${suffix}" -o /tmp/snyk && chmod +x /tmp/snyk && sudo -n mv -f /tmp/snyk /usr/local/bin/snyk; }
[ -n "$SNYK_TOKEN" ] && snyk auth="$SNYK_TOKEN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
[ -f package.json ] && npm install || true
